boundary: Games and turns selected from metadata independent of all VCRs and T outcomes, excluding every frozen V6 C5 game and V9 validation game. Tminus1 stock Firecloud candidate edges, normal route passenger hypotheses and ordinary negative controls are ALL frozen before T archive observations. Only stationary Warp0 initiators without Tminus1 tow requests and unambiguous targets are in scope. A mine-risk passenger's arrival is conditional on no mine hit; post-Host T may also reflect combat, chunnel, fuel transfer, refuelling or loss. Even an actor-at-target and 50KT drop plus passenger match is observational concordance, not independently executed Host phase proof. No VCR, inferred combat site or causal mine-RNG rule is used. SAME historical public100 corpus is not a new independent collection; this is game-disjoint diagnostic validation, not prospective deployment.

source_metadata_selection.method: fixed 12 excluded-game metadata-spaced games x 3 adjacent turn windows; no VCR or T outcome selection
